_comment: Rules for .claude/skills/judge-arch/scripts/arch-gate.mjs. A rule fails the gate when a file matching 'include' (and not 'exclude') contains any 'forbid' pattern (JS regex source). 'name' appears in the output and in waivers, so keep it stable. Add layer-boundary rules here as the app's architecture is decided (for example: UI code must not call the database directly). Built-in checks for empty catch blocks and swallowed errors run on all JS/TS files.

rules.name: hardcodedSecret
rules.message: A value that looks like a credential is written into code. Read it from the environment or a secrets store, and rotate it if it was ever committed.

rules.name: noEval
rules.message: Running a string as code is an injection risk. Use a data format or a lookup table instead.
